title: Aromatic Venezuelan Almond Salad
description: An earthy, silky salad that blends roasted sweet potato, blanched green beans, and quinoa with a creamy almond butter dressing, perfect for a romantic Venezuelan-inspired dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.
Toss sweet potato cubes with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roast for 25 minutes until tender.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil, add green beans, blanch for 2 minutes, then transfer to ice water to stop cooking.
In a small bowl, whisk together almond butter, lime juice, olive oil, dijon mustard, and salt until smooth.
Cook quinoa according to package, let cool to room temperature.
In a large salad bowl, combine mixed greens, cooked quinoa, roasted sweet potato, blanched green beans, and sliced almonds.
Drizzle the almond butter dressing over the salad and toss gently to coat evenly.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
